producer_report.summary:
I fixed both `athena land --pr` bugs and added tests for each. The full test run, clippy with warnings denied, and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.

**Base branch.** `PrHost` now has `default_branch()`. It reads `default_branch` from `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}`. `land_pr` asks the host for it just before opening the PR and uses it as `NewPr.base`. `Athena::land_pr` no longer calls `current_branch`, so a detached HEAD or a local-only branch can't affect the base or cause an error. To make this work, `LandPr.pr` is now a `PrDraft` (title, body, head), and the base is filled in when the PR is opened.

**Work branch contents.** I added `Git::commit_with_records` in `athena-git`. It builds a commit on top of the candidate whose tree is the candidate's tree with `records/` replaced by the `records/` from local HEAD. The new `gh::work_commit` wraps that helper. The fingerprint ignores `records/`, so it stays equal to the verified one, and the new commit descends from the candidate, so the push guard still holds. `LandPr.candidate` is replaced by a `work_commit` closure. It runs only when a branch is about to be published, so a rerun that finds a stored PR link doesn't create a new commit. The pushed commit, `link.head`, the merge guard sha and the checks lookup all use this new commit.

**Merge gate.** Unchanged: merging still needs `merge_via_rest` on and green checks.

**Tests added:**
- The client reads the default branch (`trunk`).
- The flow opens the PR against `trunk` and pushes, stores and checks the work commit.
- The work commit in a real git repository contains the records files and the candidate's code, descends from the candidate, and has the same fingerprint.
- The `athena-git` helper has its own test.

I also updated the design doc (steps 2 and 3 of §5.1) and the changelog. I did not need to change `pr.rs` or `land.rs`, though both were listed as deliverables.

whole workspace, including the three new tests
gh:: tests and the athena-git test pass

open_issues: The default branch is read, and the work commit built, only when a new PR is published. A rerun that finds a stored link does neither, so it needs no network call for the base.
pr.rs and land.rs are listed as deliverables but needed no change.
Nothing exercises GhCli or a real push end to end. The tests use fakes for the host and remote, plus a real git repository for the work-commit construction.
mistakes: My first attempt to edit with a heredoc script was denied by policy; I redid the edits one by one. No effect on the result.
learnings: Records are ordinary files under records/ in the local HEAD tree, and the fingerprint ignores records/, so a records-only commit on top of the candidate keeps the verified fingerprint.
Bash here allows no heredocs, python or grep; edits go through the Edit tool.
athena-git's testutil module is pub(crate), so athena-core tests build their own repositories.
desires: A way to edit files with a script (python or sed) would have saved many single-edit calls.
